meta.title: Order Activity records the event withdrawn
gaps: Verify the entry names the exact buyer who withdrew the event.
Verify the entry shows the exact date and time of withdrawal.
Verify every earlier activity is present and that all entries are in chronological order.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the entry names the exact buyer who withdrew the event.; Verify the entry shows the exact date and time of withdrawal.; Verify every earlier activity is present and that all entries are in chronological order.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create flow so the event can be configured as an RFQ.
Use an RFQ stage because the test needs a published event that can be withdrawn.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Add a QA vendor so the event is publishable and usable.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Withdraw the project with a remark, as required for the activity record.
Confirm the withdrawal completed before inspecting activity.
Open the RFQ stage's Order Activity drawer.
Confirm the activity drawer is open.
Verify the activity history contains a withdrawal entry.
